text.description_html:
Field Enterprises Door Stop Replacement Rubber Tip

This is a replacement black rubber tip for the Field Enterprises LS-25 & AS-25 Door Stop. Easy to change. They are held in place by male threads. Just unscrew the original rubber bumper tip to change it.

Specifications of Field Enterprises LS-25 Door Stop Rubber Tips

  • Tip Diameter: 13/16"
  • Thread Diameter: 1/2"
  • Overall Length: 13/16"
  • Material: Black Rubber

Warning: These work for FEI-LS-25 Decorative Reed Wall Mount Door Stop 4 Inch & FEI-AS-25 Crane Neck Floor Mount Door Stop 4 Inch manufactured by Field Enterprises. If you are not sure if your door stops were manufactured by Field Enterprises, do NOT order these as they may not fit properly.

*Sold individually - NO RETURNS
